Manish Panchal Email Id: mohanpanchal.268@gmail.com Business Analyst Mob No: +91-9004221765

PROFESSIONAL SUMMARY:

Business Analyst with over 7 years of Capital Market domain experience. Expert on business requirements, user acceptance testing and end- user acceptance testing. Exceptional ability to proactively communicate with client, impact of changes and analyze business information needs. Understanding of front office, middle office and back office for trade life cycle management in equity, commodities and derivatives.

WORK EXPERIENCE :

PwC India – Senior Consultant (Duration: - 19th September 2024 – Present)

Client: Yes Bank (Currently working with Yes Bank as client) ➢ Automated MIS and regulatory reports by analysing source data, designing logic & documenting business requirement documents (BRD) and Functional requirements documents Client: Nomura ➢ Led the rationalization of contracts by reviewing and optimizing existing contractual agreements to ensure they are efficient, cost-effective, and aligned with the organization strategic goal. ➢ Conducted a thorough analysis of trends and historical data for domain Independent Price Verification (IPV), Risk and Finance, offering insights that supported informed decision making and strategic planning Client: IndusInd Bank ➢ Analyzed and documented the “As-Is” data migration between Enterprise Data Warehouse and Electronic Data Processing systems for

IndusInd bank, identifying inefficiencies and gaps, and proposed “To-Be” process with strategic improvements to enhance operational efficiency and decision making.

➢ Prepared Functional Specification Documents (FSD) to facilitate the transition and guide the implementation.

NSEIT - Business Analyst (Duration: - 1st September 2021 – 31st August 2024)

Client- Clearing Corporation of India Limited ➢ Ability to leverage comprehensive understanding of CSS (legacy) & Enotice system functionalities and its database schema to design

development of products, data migration transitions and enhanced user experiences for New CSS Web Application portal for Membership Maintenance

➢ Transformed manual membership onboarding processes into efficient digital systems, employing analytical insights to identify bottlenecks, define requirements, and collaborate cross-functionally to implement automated solutions, ensuring they are feasible, scalable, and aligned with organizational goals

➢ Proficient in crafting comprehensive documentation including detailed requirement documents, user stories, use cases, and process flow

diagrams, encompassing stakeholders.

➢ Act as a bridge between business stakeholders and technical teams, ensuring clear communication and understanding of requirements,

priorities, changes and giving the demo to the business user

➢ Collaborate with quality assurance (QA) teams to define test cases, validate solutions, and ensure that the onboarding and maintenance

processes work as intended and ensure processes are comply with industry regulations, data privacy laws and organizational policies.

➢ Manage and prioritize tasks, timelines, and deliverables related to member onboarding and maintenance projects, ensuring successful and

timely completion.

Client – Refinitiv (An LSEG Business) ➢ Working for client Refinitiv (An LSEG Business) which provides solution to broking industry with different application ranging from Trading

platform Omnesys NEST, NT Web and Mobile application, Risk Management solution

➢ Scanning of the Exchanges Circular daily, if there is new requirement in the system or any changes which needs to be done in the system ➢ Preparation of Business Requirement Document based on the requirement and queries raised. ➢ Scanning and understanding of the API document given by the exchanges for their new trading platform for adding new features. ➢ Major Projects: SEBI RMS Rules, QUOD – New Trading Platform, implemented regulatory and compliance changes given by SEBI

Organization: 63 Moons Technologies: Junior Business Analyst (Duration: -24th February 2020 – 30th August 2021)

➢ Preparation of Concept Document to give brief idea about the requirement to the client. ➢ Preparation of business requirement document (BRD/BRS) based on inputs & queries raised ➢ Preparation of change request (CR) document and Software Release Notes document ➢ Functioning as the primary liaison between the business line, various departments (MCX) and the technical areas throughout the project life

cycle and act as a bridge between client and internal teams

➢ The involvement is in complete Software Development Life Cycle,right from user interactions/requirement gathering and up to complete

delivery of project

➢ Interacted with the business stake holders to keep the requirements in line with their expectations and also to act as facilitator

between the stake holder and other resources working on the configuration.

➢ Major Projects: SEBI regulatory reporting, Daily Price Range, Spread IOC

Marketplace Technologies | Designation: Management Trainee (Duration: -7th August 2018 – 20th February 2020)

➢ Requirement gathering/elicitation & requirement analyzing of BSEIndia website, BSE Sammaan CSR portal, IBBI website. ➢ Understanding thoroughly of complete buisness process/ flow for every new requirement & creating Buisness

requirement specification (BRS) document for the same.

➢ Creating workflow diagrams, flow chart for the respective requirement. ➢ Creating wireframes based on the new requirements of BSEIndia website. ➢ Making user acceptance testing of the new requirements for BSEIndia website functionality & BSE Sammaan. ➢ Maintaining the seamless co-ordination between technical team & the client. ➢ Keeping track of project status,timelines and their respective developments & presenting in every project review meeting ➢ Maintaining every Minutes of meetings in detailed manner & project co-ordination. ➢ Constant monitoring of the websites & resolving any relevant issue if exist ➢ Major Projects : Revamped of BSEIndia website, BSE Sammaan

TECHNICAL SKILL SET:

Microsoft Office Suite applications: Word, Excel, Power Point and Outlook Project Methodologies: Waterfall, Agile (Scrum) Software/Tools: Redmine, Jira, Confluence, SQL Server, GitLab Others Skills Set: Requirement Gathering, Business Analysis, SDLC, Capital Markets

EDUCATION QUALIFICATION :

Year Degree 2018 2014

MMS (Finance) B.E (Computer Science)

Institute MET institute Of Management Vidyavardhini College of Engineering and Technology

Board/University University Of Mumbai University Of Mumbai

Result MMS -73.15% B.E -61%

VOLUNTEER (MENTOR EXPERIENCE):

Volunteer (Mentor), The Green Batti Project [December 2014 - March 2015] ➢ Mentor the child through the concept of one-to-one mentee and mentor pair, provided consistent experiences through positive session and also gave exposure to new technologies and future career path in life Volunteer For Teach for India [January 2016 – February 2016] ➢ Assist the Teach for India fellow by doing volunteering work like teaching math’s, checking paper.

CERTIFICATION ➢ NISM Series - XV Research Analyst, NISM Series - VII Securities Operation and Risk Management, NISM Series - VIII Equity Derivatives, NISM Series - VA Mutual Fund Distributors, NCFM – Technical Analysis Module

PwC India – Senior Consultant (Duration: - 19th September 2024 – Present)
Client: Yes Bank (Currently working with Yes Bank as client) ➢ Automated MIS and regulatory reports by analysing source data, designing logic & documenting business requirement documents (BRD) and Functional requirements documents Client: Nomura ➢ Led the rationalization of contracts by reviewing and optimizing existing contractual agreements to ensure they are efficient, cost-effective, and aligned with the organization strategic goal. ➢ Conducted a thorough analysis of trends and historical data for domain Independent Price Verification (IPV), Risk and Finance, offering insights that supported informed decision making and strategic planning Client: IndusInd Bank ➢ Analyzed and documented the “As-Is” data migration between Enterprise Data Warehouse and Electronic Data Processing systems for
IndusInd bank, identifying inefficiencies and gaps, and proposed “To-Be” process with strategic improvements to enhance operational efficiency and decision making.
➢ Prepared Functional Specification Documents (FSD) to facilitate the transition and guide the implementation.
NSEIT - Business Analyst (Duration: - 1st September 2021 – 31st August 2024)
Client- Clearing Corporation of India Limited ➢ Ability to leverage comprehensive understanding of CSS (legacy) & Enotice system functionalities and its database schema to design
development of products, data migration transitions and enhanced user experiences for New CSS Web Application portal for Membership Maintenance
➢ Transformed manual membership onboarding processes into efficient digital systems, employing analytical insights to identify bottlenecks, define requirements, and collaborate cross-functionally to implement automated solutions, ensuring they are feasible, scalable, and aligned with organizational goals
➢ Proficient in crafting comprehensive documentation including detailed requirement documents, user stories, use cases, and process flow
diagrams, encompassing stakeholders.
➢ Act as a bridge between business stakeholders and technical teams, ensuring clear communication and understanding of requirements,
priorities, changes and giving the demo to the business user
➢ Collaborate with quality assurance (QA) teams to define test cases, validate solutions, and ensure that the onboarding and maintenance
processes work as intended and ensure processes are comply with industry regulations, data privacy laws and organizational policies.
➢ Manage and prioritize tasks, timelines, and deliverables related to member onboarding and maintenance projects, ensuring successful and
timely completion.
Client – Refinitiv (An LSEG Business) ➢ Working for client Refinitiv (An LSEG Business) which provides solution to broking industry with different application ranging from Trading
platform Omnesys NEST, NT Web and Mobile application, Risk Management solution
➢ Scanning of the Exchanges Circular daily, if there is new requirement in the system or any changes which needs to be done in the system ➢ Preparation of Business Requirement Document based on the requirement and queries raised. ➢ Scanning and understanding of the API document given by the exchanges for their new trading platform for adding new features. ➢ Major Projects: SEBI RMS Rules, QUOD – New Trading Platform, implemented regulatory and compliance changes given by SEBI
Organization: 63 Moons Technologies: Junior Business Analyst (Duration: -24th February 2020 – 30th August 2021)
➢ Preparation of Concept Document to give brief idea about the requirement to the client. ➢ Preparation of business requirement document (BRD/BRS) based on inputs & queries raised ➢ Preparation of change request (CR) document and Software Release Notes document ➢ Functioning as the primary liaison between the business line, various departments (MCX) and the technical areas throughout the project life
cycle and act as a bridge between client and internal teams
➢ The involvement is in complete Software Development Life Cycle,right from user interactions/requirement gathering and up to complete
delivery of project
➢ Interacted with the business stake holders to keep the requirements in line with their expectations and also to act as facilitator
between the stake holder and other resources working on the configuration.
➢ Major Projects: SEBI regulatory reporting, Daily Price Range, Spread IOC
Marketplace Technologies | Designation: Management Trainee (Duration: -7th August 2018 – 20th February 2020)
➢ Requirement gathering/elicitation & requirement analyzing of BSEIndia website, BSE Sammaan CSR portal, IBBI website. ➢ Understanding thoroughly of complete buisness process/ flow for every new requirement & creating Buisness
requirement specification (BRS) document for the same.
➢ Creating workflow diagrams, flow chart for the respective requirement. ➢ Creating wireframes based on the new requirements of BSEIndia website. ➢ Making user acceptance testing of the new requirements for BSEIndia website functionality & BSE Sammaan. ➢ Maintaining the seamless co-ordination between technical team & the client. ➢ Keeping track of project status,timelines and their respective developments & presenting in every project review meeting ➢ Maintaining every Minutes of meetings in detailed manner & project co-ordination. ➢ Constant monitoring of the websites & resolving any relevant issue if exist ➢ Major Projects : Revamped of BSEIndia website, BSE Sammaan
TECHNICAL SKILL SET:
Microsoft Office Suite applications: Word, Excel, Power Point and Outlook Project Methodologies: Waterfall, Agile (Scrum) Software/Tools: Redmine, Jira, Confluence, SQL Server, GitLab Others Skills Set: Requirement Gathering, Business Analysis, SDLC, Capital Markets
